content.short: Symbiotic is a permissionless and collateral-agnostic restaking protocol on Ethereum.
content.description: Symbiotic is a foundational restaking infrastructure that enables decentralized networks to bootstrap their economic security in a modular and flexible manner. Unlike traditional restaking models, Symbiotic is collateral-agnostic, allowing any ERC-20 token to be used as a security asset. This coordination layer empowers protocols to customize their own staking rules, reward structures, and node operator selection, fostering a more diverse and resilient ecosystem for decentralized security. The protocol provides the essential building blocks for networks to achieve robust security without the constraints of specific asset requirements.
